rule: A case is passed only when every test listed under it is green at the named revision AND every live-evidence artifact it requires exists and is named here. A green suite alone proves nothing; an empty tests list is a gap, not a pass.
test_id_format: unit::<module>::tests::<fn> for lib tests; <integration binary>::<module path>::<fn> for tests/ (binary = file stem, or the directory name for tests/<dir>/main.rs trees).

status_vocabulary.unmapped: no test or evidence named yet
status_vocabulary.mapped: tests named; not yet re-run at the claimed revision
status_vocabulary.blocked: depends on an open ADR 012 workstream item listed under open_items
status_vocabulary.passed: tests green at revision and live evidence present
status_vocabulary.live_pending: tests green; live evidence still to be produced
